tickets.title: Make the resting screen answer three questions without a tap
tickets.player_problem: The opening minute reads as a counter being decremented: the primary label mutates five ways for one continuing choice, a failed tap never states the shortfall, and idle production has no visible or numeric signal.
tickets.hypothesis: A stable primary label, numeric shortfall inside the toast, and one numeric idle beat per production cycle let one persona state next action, shortfall and current output from the resting screen alone.
non_goals: No new currency, machine, panel or second screen
No audio work this slice (deferred behind the numeric idle line)
acceptance: on a fresh start, about 20 taps at 250 ms, then without opening any panel the persona writes three sentences (next tap effect, last shortfall amount, current output) that all match the sim state read from the same build
the primary label string does not change while the underlying choice stays the same
the same three-sentence run on 24daf0e is recorded as the negative control and the candidate is strictly better than its own base, otherwise the slice is reverted
layout floor holds: no page scroll and every tap target >= 44 CSS px at text scale 1 and 2
evidence: work/product/PLAY-001-decision-g1.md (preview acceptance, v1 MET at the tap-20 frame, v2 approved prospectively)
work/review/PLAY-001-g1-qa.md (independent QA at 487d3ca, own gates plus chromium readouts at four viewport/scale combinations)
work/development/handoffs/PLAY-001-g1.md (developer handoff with its own chromium receipts)
work/feedback/PLAY-001-g1-persona.json (one simulated persona, two runs, per-node label census; raw probe PNG/JSON files stay in the temp dir)

tests/ui/resting-screen.test.tsx (6 cases: P-1 numeric shortfall, P-1 credit price, P-2 resting fleet/power at 0 machines, P-3 one label per committed choice, P-4 pip legend, P-5 credits chip at zero)
work/deployments/OPS-010-g1.json browser_smoke (the three strings re-read on the live route)
tickets.outcome: Three questions are answerable on the resting screen with no panel open, verified on the deployed artifact at 390x844: the blocked toast prints the numbers ('Need 20 scrap · have 0', and 'Need 5 ferrous · have 2' style for a mixed price), the status line carries 'Drones 1 · Power 8 · 0 requested · 100 %' from the first tick while machines is still 0, and the primary keeps one string across the build/place flip ('Build Scrap sorter20 scrap', 3 distinct labels and 2 transitions in 60 taps against the base's 4 and 45; 17 vs 23 distinct and 30 vs 579 transitions over 700 taps). Once machines exist the legend names the counted quantity per machine ('Batch pips · Scrap sorter 1/5 · Furnace 1/5 · Polymer recycler 0/5 +1'), matching the renderer's own max(1, ceil(ratio x 5)) quantisation. The entry chunk costs 937 B (231,520 B, 1,480 B under the ceiling); no simulation number moved (behaviour line identical, save checksum eede3c4f, schemaVersion 1, the three new reject fields never enter JSON.stringify(state)).
tickets.acceptance_revision: v1 (the ~20-tap three-sentence check) is what this generation is graded on, and the earlier NOT MET at that fixed checkpoint stays on the record unchanged. The product owner retires the fixed tap-count checkpoint prospectively as the wrong instrument (at tap 20 machines == 0, so the legend and two-machine separability are structurally untestable there, and one tap index lands on different ladder phases across builds): **PLAY-001 v2** replaces it with state-named checkpoints C1 (machines == 0 with a non-null toast), C2 (machines == 1), C3 (machines >= 2), a per-committed-step label rule (distinct(primaryLabel) == 1 per step, labelTransitions <= stepChanges + 1 over 700 taps) and a three-part comparison against its own base. v1's verdict is not re-derived backwards. Chrome follow-ups are fixed as CH-1 (card <= 42 % of the .hud content box at both viewports and both text scales, with that box's height printed), CH-2 (no overlap with the dock, yard coverage inside the pinned band) and CH-3 (legend names at most two machines before collapsing); the last rejection becomes one trailing status-line segment next slice.

tickets.title: Give the three named plans unequal prices so the tradeoff is readable at rest
tickets.player_problem: All three named plans cost the same, so the dock is three buttons whose labels differ by one word and a player cannot say what the chosen plan costs them that the others do not.
tickets.hypothesis: A price difference is the smallest change that puts 'what I gave up' on the resting screen as a fact rather than as a claim in a harness; it is falsifiable in one persona run and costs no card chrome at 360x640.
scope: src/ui (price already prints on the button)
work/feedback (one persona run plus the equal-price control)
non_goals: No new currency, machine or panel
No tile batch clock, second wreck or second resource (deferred by the product owner)
No expedition or defense groundwork
acceptance: fresh storage, one persona keeps one named plan, 40 taps at 250 ms, then without opening a panel writes three sentences: (1) what the plan makes more of, (2) what it costs that the other plan does not, (3) which button to press when starting over
pass = sentences (1) and (2) name two different quantities readable on the resting screen and (3) names a different button than the one pressed
negative control: the same run on the equal-price build must fail sentence (2); if it does not fail, the control is not a control and the check is retired
the harness rows keep the price in the scored set so the price change is reproducible without a browser
evidence: work/product/PLAY-001-decision-g1.md section 5 (the chosen next outcome, with the deferred alternatives and their reasons)
